message: 大人と子供の境界線
We will now begin the extraordinary student general meeting.

name: Synn
message: 「...Wait, that's way too normal.」
The student general meeting is starting\s07

name: Synn
message: 「Too casual.」
Student general meeting, let us commence fairly and squarely!!

name: Synn
message: 「Too stiff.」
The student general meeting is starting!?

name: Synn
message: 「What am I, Paqy?!」
Uugh... What am I supposed to do...

name: Paqy
message: 「Guoo~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Seriously, completely oblivious to how I'm feeling...」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go. Have some tea♪」

name: Ria
message: 「What's the matter? Is something troubling you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「You didn't even notice me brewing the tea. You must have been really focused.」
I get the feeling she pops up out of nowhere just as much as Helena-san.

name: Ria
message: 「Did everyone head off somewhere?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. They're out notifying the students... As for me, I've been trying to come up with what to say in my speech, and ended up like this.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see.」
Looking at the desk covered in eraser shavings, Ria-senpai smiled as if amused.

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai... do you happen to have any good ideas?」

name: Ria
message: 「Is this year's Student Council President the type to give up so easily?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no, it's not that I'm giving up or anything, it's just...」

name: Ria
message: 「How disappointing~~ To think you're someone who immediately relies on others.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, not at all! I'll think of something, I'll do my best on my own. Alright, I've got this!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, just kidding♪ That's what I'm here as an advisor for, after all.」
It's embarrassing feeling like she can see right through me.

name: Ria
message: 「You know, Synn-kun, asking other people is super easy, right? That's why you end up just asking them」

name: Ria
message: 「If you keep relying on others like that, you'll be in trouble when the time comes that you have to figure things out on your own」

name: Ria
message: 「So, that's why I think if you're going to ask someone, you should come up with your own ideas first♪」

name: Synn
message: 「You make a very good point...」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll wait right here until you think of something, okay?」
Ria-senpai sat down directly across from me and rested her chin in both hands.
Ria-senpai watched me, swaying her head side to side as I scratched away with my pen.

name: Synn
message: 「This is the very first event since our Student Council was formed, isn't it?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right」

name: Synn
message: 「When I think about whether everyone will approve of it, I just get so anxious...」

name: Ria
message: 「I see. So that's why you're stuck」
Ria-senpai stood up slowly and sat down next to me this time.

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun, how do you want all the students to feel at this festival?」

name: Synn
message: 「Feel...」

name: Ria
message: 「What kind of memories do you want everyone to take away from it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I want them to have fun. I want it to be a fun memory for them」

name: Ria
message: 「And what about you, Synn-kun?」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't forget, you're one of the students too, Synn-kun」

name: Ria
message: 「Let me ask you again. How do you want to feel?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I want to have fun too」

name: Ria
message: 「Exactly! That's why you have to put yourself in a fun mood first」

name: Ria
message: 「You won't come up with any fun ideas making a face like thiiis\s04」
She pinched my cheeks with her soft fingertips and stretched them sideways.

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shtop ihh」

name: Ria
message: 「Now up and down, streeetch」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmph-gaaah!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, your skin... is really pretty, isn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Mmmm. Kind of frustrating...」

name: Ria
message: 「Take this, take that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. Sorry, sorry. That lovely skin of yours is gonna get all stretched out, isn't it」

name: Synn
message: 「All stretched out...」

name: Ria
message: 「Aaah! No, you can't write that down!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a collection of Senpai's famous quotes!」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez! No way, no way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, give me back my pencil!」

name: Ria
message: 「Not giving it baaack unless you promise not to do anything weird」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hmm... Sounds like someone's having fun--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa?! Is this my chaaance to get all tangled up with Ria-chan!!」

name: Helena
message: 「However, here comes the steal!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gwah」

name: Helena
message: 「A magnificent dribble, and then--」

name: Helena
message: 「Dunk shoooot!」
Paqy was slammed into the ground.

name: Helena
message: 「'Hmph... Nailed it...'」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Helena-san...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey, Synn-chan. What are you doing flirting with my cute Ria?」

name: Ria
message: 「H-Hey, stop that!\s03」

name: Helena
message: 「Mmh\s04 They feel just as good as ever\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Mfufu♪ Do you want to touch them too, Synn-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hyaa! I-I could never... do something like that!」

name: Helena
message: 「What's with getting shy now? That's what you were doing just a moment ago, wasn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha!? I was not!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Even though you two were fooling around behind my back」

name: Synn
message: 「F-Fooling...!?」

name: Helena
message: 「If you could touch them, you'd want to, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「O-Onee-chan, really! Synn-kun isn't that kind of perverted boy!! Right?」

name: Helena
message: 「Really~?」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez! Look, you're troubling Synn-kun!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, what a kind big sister. In that case, stop playing around and hurry up and finish putting your speech together」

name: Ria
message: 「Urk」

name: Helena
message: 「Hehehe, Ria really is still just a kid~~」
Helena-san gave a little wave of her hand and walked out.
Ria-senpai stuck her tongue out at her retreating back.

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't doing things like that why she calls you childish...」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, you dummy, dummy, dummy, Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Ria-senpai, st-stop it!」
I writhed under an attack that tickled far more than it hurt.

name: Ria
message: 「Listen up, Synn-kun! You are to finish summarizing that speech right this instant! That's an order from your senpai!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes ma'am...」

name: Ria
message: 「If there's anything you don't understand, feel free to ask your senpai anything at all. Special service\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」
Seriously, she changes her tune so fast, I can't tell if she's mature or childish....
